issue.title: Don't use an asserting searcher at all in MatchingDirectoryReader

labels.name: >test
labels.description: Issues or PRs that are addressing/adding tests

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Follow up to #100527

We are not testing anything to do with searching with this searcher, and so
there is no point in using `LuceneTestCase.newSearcher()` which will wrap
it with all sorts of extra checks that may access the underlying reader in
ways that are not anticipated by tests.

Fixes #100460
Fixes #99024
